addition.item: Added changelog URL to the manifest file.
Added the changelog.xml file and corrected the URL in the update server file.
Added a configuration option to add tags if the user has a confirmed HikaShop order.
Implemented plugin functionality to add tags to contacts after querying the HikaShop database for a successful order with confirmed status.

change.item: Updated the extension version information in the manifest file.
Updated version information and removed Joomla 4 support from the installer script.

Moved from using the generic event which retrieves an array of arguments to 
AbstractUserEvent
with properly typed code and event arguments using the modern Joomla 5 approach.

Changed the variable type from the generic 
Event
class to the concrete 
AfterSaveEvent
.
Removed FIELD from language tags for concision.
Modified the About API plugin description to use HTML formatting and corrected the English language string.

fix.item: Added new language strings for invalid or missing API keys and implemented the proper return value for the Form field class.
Improved Mailchimp API key validation by handling malformed keys, API request failures, and empty list responses directly within the plugin field logic instead of using enqueuemessage.

addition.item: Initial release of the Chimpounga plugin (formerly Xchimp2).

change.item: Renamed the plugin from Xchimp2 to Chimpounga.
